text:
Limestone is used to reduce sulfur dioxide emissions from coal-fired power stations.
The equation for the reaction is shown.
CaCO3  +  SO2→  CaSO3  +  CO2
What is the smallest mass of CaCO3 required to remove 1 tonne of SO2?
A
1 tonne
B
2 tonnes
C
64 tonnes
D
100 tonnes
subject: Chemistry
